## Weekly simple XPU consolidation

Today's daily reconciliation resumed and completed **2026-10-29** after the agent's API authentication failure. Existing PR remains open and Ready for Review with **12 attributed source commits**, stacked on the benchmark CI prerequisite.
Main: `2d44b55010b61c94c3c07ea6b32e30691304ee24`. Head: `9e974b7586d30e40142df017490005d3db4fbc3b`. Branch: `xpu/weekly-simple-model-enablement-2026-10-26`.
Source pool creation cutoff: **2026-10-26T16:30:56Z**. Later-opened PRs remain deferred to next Monday.

## Included sources — one attributed commit per PR

- **#41068 @vshekhawat-hlab** — Small StableLM XPU dtype admission mirrors existing NPU cast and restores original output dtype. Source `db6b4a87a8e694861bcc91ce0df7ed0b0781059e`; commit `0612c06a3278a838a5e09a325718c72855af76f9`. Kernel proof: Contained kernel #215/#287 at release 7da01c5e0eab63d4a53231995b8c28836efff486; FusedQKRope.cpp plus Utils.h Float dispatch supports FP32 query/cache for supported partial64 rotation on head128; target StableLM-2-1.6B head64/rotary16 uses Torch fallback. Rotary32 on head128 is unsupported on main and source, not claimed enabled.
- **#41523 @Amrutha-M05** — BF16-only HiSparse admission/default on XPU and sparse prefill over translated device slots, with actionable dtype diagnostics and CLI regressions. Source `45c055b4ea2863519c04767435f28d1d2d4b623b`; commit `d85d9ae60f8cc93a96cab510398749c58154df85`. Review proof: @siju-samuel approved on 2026-10-29T06:01:15Z (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41523#pullrequestreview-5693501102), superseding the October 15 Changes Requested review; every source thread is resolved. Kernel proof: existing v0.5.0+xpu `flash_mla_sparse_fwd` BF16 q/KV, int32 translated indices and variable top-k contract exercised against a Torch reference; no unreleased kernel PR required.
- **#41644 @Zhichenzzz** — Residual two-line gated-norm device fix follows loader CPU/XPU device context; other source changes already on main. Source `109c47770ef53e8dab2e49cb858469bb9840b9dc`; commit `672d3c5da7b5273ac49d2bb5b4cb44b21124e320`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent tensor allocation/device context; existing in-tree gated norm kernels unchanged.
- **#41730 @desmond-intel** — Preserves image/video-prefill visual routing while skipping decode/text-only mask allocation; restores DLLM_EXTEND metadata and per-token indexing for unsupported non-MLA/no-DCP page sizes. Source `5328b9829f4c07967efc0a46195087e4facd3caf`; commit `5a182dce57e7ec8c0b33ccc45a7ec9f55623f10f`. Kernel proof: no new kernel API or kernel-side PR dependency; existing pinned v0.5.0+xpu page-1/64/128 paged FMHA validated against SDPA, with constructor fallback and unchanged KV pool layout verified.
- **#42831 @slokesha** — Small hybrid-cache/Triton admission and non-CUDA packed-decode capability guards. Source `cc33785bf97e78a8c0a76d54b25c1ee13f2c5627`; commit `883568a1a8106478dde4eabed98478fd9c75d780`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent existing in-tree Triton GDN and XPU prefix checkpoint paths; no new sgl_kernel API.
- **#44268 @ZhengGong-amd** — Restores fused MoE sum flag parity outside CUDA and guards LoRA hook behavior; synthetic author regression retained. Source `f5c16f775915488e3fa57e004297200caa7cf1de`; commit `78e53344e4f48a3b0439c7a7b0e81fb11c6c543d`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent in-tree Triton MoE sum/reduction dispatch; no new wheel API.
- **#44561 @hotschmoe** — CUDA-only decode import guard and device-generic PLE offload/prefetch tests on XPU. Source `28b71137aa8d7186c5628492cfbafeb455dc249d`; commit `b84a896bf93b782e840349473a9c48a73b7fb5b9`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent Torch pinned memory, XPU streams and imports; existing embedding behavior unchanged.
- **#45396 @jhsmith409** — Equivalent per-sequence unmasked vision SDPA restores native backend fast paths with explicit guarded mask fallback. Source `6343d220420d9ed365d6db9aa9af17f1ff876211`; commit `8d691a00727976156f3948dac37e50af62e6daef`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent Torch SDPA; no sgl_kernel changes.
- **#45533 @Amrutha-M05** — Deterministic XPU default selects native backend while preserving explicit overrides. Source `02bd113f45d43cd2eef55cb66ea39e2c3cb27df2`; commit `1ddda2f7b0d3985dc5ee80ded3e30ab517415aeb`. Kernel proof: Contained kernel #227/#454/#383 at release 7da01c5e0eab63d4a53231995b8c28836efff486; existing causal FMHA BF16/FP16 contract, no new API.
- **#45826 @fumiama** — Moves unsupported-GGUF warning from module import to configuration construction. Source `7d814563bcfa5f2d8efec58303082342b1436788`; commit `81a8aa3a4817d784c33af7a59c8d5d7c462f4aec`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent import/warning metadata; does not enable XPU GGUF.
- **#46514 @mlleo** — Lazily imports CUDA-only communicator so qwen4_decode imports on XPU. Source `dceb2388bb3e00960fde0da2d0f994501255a4a4`; commit `522758a9d58f300f3916a0f80f763db8094b7452`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent import admission; CUDA communicator remains gated.
- **#46529 @MeowMiaoJ** — Adds missing FFmpeg system dependency to XPU image. Source `99ca34c1e5dbec4d36dc1b95e6d6856272db5180`; commit `9e974b7586d30e40142df017490005d3db4fbc3b`. Kernel proof: Kernel-independent system package declaration; no device/operator changes.

## Requested stack and manual inclusion

Stacked on open **#47185** head `7d887176a62cd13715173e1a89b0073a4b56a773`. Its one-line benchmark fix supplies `req_to_token_pool` to the dummy tree cache, removing the shared pre-inference XPU/Xeon allocation exception. Merge #47185 before this consolidation. #47195 was closed as its duplicate. GitHub base remains main because the prerequisite branch lives in another fork.

The main SHA above is the stack parent's main merge base; fetched latest main is `686cf984704b79cb1b3f7145827c6f1922c4445d`. There are 12 attributed weekly-source commits above the prerequisite; #47185 is an explicitly requested parent, not a later-opened source-pool admission.

#41730 was manually restored at the user's request after fixing the collector's false-positive match of `query block` as kernel dependency language. Video-only routing is fixed in source `dfb591e335`; the review thread https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46623#discussion_r4397137380 still awaits reviewer resolution. A user-authorized exception is scoped to source head `5328b9829f4c07967efc0a46195087e4facd3caf`, this PR and that exact thread. Other feedback, Changes Requested, failures and kernel validation remain subject to normal rules.

## Wednesday exclusions — unresolved review or unfixed failure

Wednesday's 09:00 rebuild is the cleanup deadline. Unresolved threads, including outdated ones, and unresolved Changes Requested or source-related failures are excluded until fixed and explicitly cleared. Author replies or successful local tests do not resolve reviewer threads.

| [#41160](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41160) | Unresolved review thread (including outdated threads) — https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41160#discussion_r4125482725; Unresolved review thread (including outdated threads) — https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41160#discussion_r4125482752 |
| [#43891](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43891) | Unresolved consolidation review thread — https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46623#discussion_r4397150769 |
| [#41142](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41142) | Reproduced enabled-cache failure: the default params=None is passed to the real tree core, which raises AttributeError on params.node_id. The mocked-tree probe does not validate the real call. — python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_radix_cache.py:1117; unified_cache/unified_tree_core.py:755,796 |

#39714's invalid suite registration was reported verbatim to its author: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39714#issuecomment-6482927036 . Its patch is excluded, not edited in the consolidation. #41142's enabled-cache failure requires author adaptation to the current required-receipt tree-core contract.

## Scope and next-week deferrals

#34310, #35878 and #36215 remain excluded from direct XPU scope at their unchanged rejected source heads. #46871, #46877, #46997, #46998, #47001, #47002 and #47004 remain deferred because they opened after the fixed weekly creation cutoff.

Fresh daily eligibility still uses original source state/patches and actual main containment, not prior consolidation lists. Sources excluded by Wednesday may re-enter this week's existing pool only after failures are fixed and reviewers explicitly clear their feedback. No source branches or review threads were modified.

## Resumed daily audit

The failed job stopped at 09:19 PDT with HTTP 401 Unauthorized/API-key authentication failure, not a Python KeyError. Its repository-wide inventory (5,345 open PRs), 234 live candidate records and 174 replay audits were retained. This continuation reused that same-day scan and rechecked current source heads, reviews, pinned-kernel behavior and the exact rebuilt stack before publication. The agent credentials still reject requests; this recovery used direct GitHub/Git/native tooling.

#41523's stale Changes Requested exclusion is cleared by the later approval and resolved threads. Its other failed CI logs concern an ARM CPU kernel missing `fused_moe_router_cpu`, an MLX stub's `draft_parallel_layout` argument and a ROCm DeepSeek-V4 JIT build; they do not establish a HiSparse source failure. #44268 is refreshed to its latest author head. #41842 remains excluded for source lint failure, and the remaining review/scope/dependency/window exclusions are assessed from their current patches/state.

Recovery audit artifacts: `/root/weekly-reconcile-20261029/`; current review audit uses bounded GraphQL batches to avoid the observed HTTP 504 on the full candidate set.

## Validation

Normal pre-commit, CI registry hooks and diff checks passed. Exact-head focused native/unit verification of `9e974b7586d30e40142df017490005d3db4fbc3b`: **105 passed, 3 declared skips, 0 failures/errors**, using the exact pinned v0.5.0+xpu wheel. Receipt, commands, hardware and JUnit logs: `/root/sglang-xpu-native-2026-10-29-resumed-9e974b7586/results.json`.

#41523 policy/CLI and translated-slot native sparse-prefill checks pass. Existing #41730 video/dLLM regressions and #47185's real CPU/XPU request/KV allocation checks also pass.
